# routeros_tool_graphing (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_graphing" "graphing" {
  page_refresh = "10s"
  store_every  = "5min"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `page_refresh` (String) Automatic refresh interval of the graphing web pages, in seconds, or `never` to disable the automatic refresh.
> The property is not purely numeric (`/console/inspect request=completion path=tool,graphing input="set page-refresh="` offers `never`), so it is declared as a string.
- `store_every` (String) How often to write the collected data to the system drive.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/tool/graphing get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_tool_graphing.graphing "*1"
```
